Terms & Conditions

Welcome to SelectedByNoks. By placing an order or booking a service with us, you acknowledge that you have read and accepted these terms.

1. Orders & Payments

  • Orders are only confirmed once payment requirements communicated by SelectedByNoks have been met.
  • Customers are responsible for confirming the correct wig, colour, length, and requested services before payment.
  • Prices may change from time to time. The price confirmed at the time of your order will apply.
  • Sale prices apply only during the advertised promotion period.

2. Wig Care & Use

  • Customers are responsible for following appropriate wig-care instructions after receiving their wig.
  • Damage caused by improper washing, excessive heat, chemicals, colouring, cutting, alterations, or general misuse may not be treated as a product defect.
  • Please inspect your wig as soon as you receive it and contact us promptly if there is a genuine issue.

3. Customisation & Extra Services

  • Styling and plucking are additional services charged separately.
  • Customised wigs may differ slightly from reference photographs because each wig is individually prepared.
  • Once a wig has been customised, the requested customisation cannot be reversed.

4. Delivery & Collection

  • Delivery or collection arrangements and any applicable fees will be communicated before the order is completed.
  • Customers must provide accurate contact and delivery information.
  • SelectedByNoks is not responsible for delays caused by third-party couriers, incorrect delivery information, or circumstances outside our reasonable control.

5. Non-Refund Policy

Change-of-mind refunds are not offered. Because wigs are personal-use/hygiene products and may be customised, we do not accept returns or refunds simply because a customer changes their mind, chooses the wrong style, colour or length, or no longer wants the item.

However, this policy does not remove any consumer rights that cannot legally be excluded. Under South Africa's Consumer Protection Act, consumers have remedies where goods are defective, unsafe, of poor quality, or otherwise fail to meet the applicable legal requirements. citeturn0search19turn0search20

If you believe you received a defective or incorrect item, contact SelectedByNoks with your order details and clear photographs so that the matter can be assessed.

6. Exchanges & Complaints

  • Any issue with an order should be reported as soon as reasonably possible after delivery or collection.
  • Where a statutory remedy applies, SelectedByNoks will follow the requirements of applicable South African consumer law.
  • We reserve the right to inspect an item when assessing a reported defect or incorrect item.

7. Website Information

  • We aim to display product photographs, colours, prices and descriptions accurately. Screen settings and lighting may cause slight colour differences.
  • Product availability is subject to stock.

8. Contact

For orders, questions or complaints, please contact SelectedByNoks through the WhatsApp button on this website.

Important: This policy is intended as a clear business policy and does not replace applicable South African law. Where a law gives a consumer a right or remedy, that right takes priority over any conflicting term.
